question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bounce**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5 is **bounce.**
 
• The term "**bounce**" aligns well with the action of a ball landing on the roof of the house or landing in the rambler roses and causing a shower of petals. When a ball hits a surface and returns upwards, it is said to "**bounce**."
 
• In the context provided, the word "**bounce**" indicates the action of the ball rebounding or springing off the surface after it lands on the roof or the roses. This action would lead to a shower of petals, as described in the passage.
 
• The term "**bounce**" best fits the context of a ball's action after it lands on a surface, causing the described effect of petals falling down.

 

Correct Passage:__ *And you could hardly call it a game at all, because Uncle Bob held his racket as though he had hold of a shovel, and tried to scoop up every ball that came over the net, even those he should have left for Uncle Ted. And then he took off his shirt and played in just his trousers and stockinged feet, and with his face split nearly in two by his grin, he started jumping over the net, and playing on Arnold's side instead. And the ball would **bounce** on the roof of the house, or land in the rambler roses and bring down a shower of petals, and getting it again Uncle Bob would shake down more petals all over himself, so they'd be in his hair.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__***

 
• Bounce :The action where an object or person moves quickly away from a surface or area after hitting it, usually under the influence of some force. Also, it can mean having resilience, an ability to recover from setbacks.
 
 
• **Example: **The ball will bounce if you drop it on the floor.
 
• Hindi: उछाल
 
 
• उदाहरण: अगर आप गेंद को फर्श पर गिराते हैं, तो यह उछलेगी।
 
 
 
 
 
• Flake : A small, thin piece of something, typically one that has broken away or been peeled off from a larger piece.
 
 
• Example: A flake of snow fell on her nose.
 
 
• Hindi: टुकड़ा
 
 
• उदाहरण: एक बर्फ का टुकड़ा उसकी नाक पर गिरा।
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Jump : To push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet.
 
 
• Example: She jumped over the puddle to keep her shoes dry.
 
• Hindi: कूदना
 
 
• उदाहरण: उसने अपने जूतों को सूखा रखने के लिए कीचड़ के ऊपर कूद लिया।
 
 
 
 
 
• Leap : To make a large jump or sudden movement, usually from one place to another.
 
 
• Example: He had to leap over the fence to escape the angry dog.
 
• Hindi: उछलना
 
• उदाहरण: उसे क्रोधित कुत्ते से बचने के लिए बाड़ के ऊपर उछलना पड़ा।
